description: Use this when you need CSV data as JSON objects. Example prompt: "Turn this CSV export into JSON." Parse CSV data into JSON with delimiter auto-detection and quoted-field handling. Costs 1 credit. The answer is deterministic.

csv.description: The CSV text; the delimiter is detected automatically

firstRowHeaders.description: Treat the first row as column names and return objects (default true)

name: csv_to_json

result.description: The result, when it is not an object

title: CSV to JSON
